name: Silly Jokes for Funny Kids by Andrew Pinder

pages.title: Silly Jokes For Funny Kids - Dubray Books
pages.description: A new title in the 'Buster Laugh-a-Lot' series, this hilarious collection has over 300 silly jokes for funny kids to enjoy and share.  What do you call blueberries playing music together? A jam session.  What do you call a magic dog? A labracadabrador.  Why was the monster so full? He was goblin his pie.  Brimming with over 300 laugh-out-loud jokes split into ten chapters, from Alien Antics and Silly Schoolin' to Zany Zingers and Gross Giggles, this is the ultimate collection of silly jokes that every funny kid needs to know. Designed to be easy to read and accompanied by hilarious illustrations by Andrew Pinder for extra fun, this comical collection will have young jokers howling with laughter.
